name: How long does a kitchen renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most kitchen upgrades take anywhere from two to eight weeks depending on project scope. Cosmetic updates like tile backsplashes, interior painting, and trim carpentry often wrap up in one to two weeks. Full-scale renovations involving custom framing, cabinet installation, sub-trade rough-ins, and drywall finish work generally take four to eight weeks. Lead times for ordered materials like custom cabinetry or stone countertops frequently dictate the overall schedule, so finalizing selections before demolition begins keeps work moving without mid-project delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen upgrades generally take two to eight weeks, depending on whether the project is a cosmetic refresh or a full renovation involving framing, drywall, and trade rough-ins.
